title: Multi-admin approval is not configured for any operation

messages.businessImpact: A single compromised or mistaken administrator account can push a policy, script or application to the whole estate with nothing standing in the way. Multi-admin approval is the control that turns that from one action into two.
messages.technicalDetail: Access policies under Tenant administration require a second administrator to approve changes to the protected operation before they take effect.
remediation: Create an access policy for Scripts and one for Apps as a starting point, since both can execute code on every device.
Name an approver group with at least two members who are not the usual policy authors.
Extend to Device actions and Role assignments once the process is established.
messages.cannotSee: Intune offers no switch on an access policy, so a policy counts as in force when it names an approver group.
